scientific_claim_under_consideration: A low-turnover, delta-neutral, pre-funded long-Binance-perpetual / short-Hyperliquid-perpetual position may capture a persistent cross-venue funding premium after basis PnL, fees, execution costs, collateral fragmentation, opportunity cost and venue-separate margin risk.

data_partition_policy.replication_window_rule: After provenance audit, use the earliest common full UTC month with unambiguous funding semantics and acceptable coverage for both BTC and ETH across both venues, ending no later than 2025-12-31T23:59:59.999Z. The start date is determined only by source availability/coverage rules, never by carry outcomes.
data_partition_policy.fixed_cohort_rule: BTC and ETH use one common replication window; no symbol-specific start chosen from outcomes.
data_partition_policy.extension_rule: No opportunistic extension after economic outcomes are observed.

coverage_gates_before_full_freeze.funding_records: All realized settlement records must be timestamped, deduplicated and coverage-audited for each venue/symbol.
coverage_gates_before_full_freeze.expected_settlement_schedule: Must be derived from dated venue rules and actual regime changes, not assumed to be permanently 8h or 1h.
coverage_gates_before_full_freeze.timestamp_standard: UTC milliseconds internally; source timezone semantics documented.
coverage_gates_before_full_freeze.duplicates: Exact duplicates may be canonicalized only by a deterministic pre-registered rule; conflicting duplicates fail closed.
coverage_gates_before_full_freeze.missing_funding_events: No interpolation. Missing required events are explicit missingness and may trigger NO_GO if material.
coverage_gates_before_full_freeze.regime_ambiguity: Any period with unresolved rate-scaling or settlement-interval semantics is excluded only by a pre-registered provenance rule, never by economic result.
coverage_gates_before_full_freeze.raw_fingerprint: SHA-256 over canonical raw-record manifests required before economic evaluation.

cashflow_specification.unit_of_account: USD-equivalent with venue-native collateral tracked separately
cashflow_specification.base_quantity_matching: For each asset, long and short legs use equal absolute base-asset quantity unless the final freeze documents a venue contract multiplier requiring deterministic conversion.
cashflow_specification.binance_long_funding_cashflow: negative when Binance funding rate is positive; computed from the venue-defined funding notional at the actual settlement timestamp
cashflow_specification.hyperliquid_short_funding_cashflow: positive when Hyperliquid funding rate is positive; computed from venue-defined funding notional at the actual hourly settlement timestamp
cashflow_specification.funding_comparison: Never annualize first. Sum actual settlement cashflows first; APR/APY may only be derived after full economic accounting in an authorized later phase.
cashflow_specification.price_pnl: Track each perp leg separately. Consolidated price PnL is the sum of long-Binance and short-Hyperliquid price PnL and therefore captures cross-venue basis divergence/convergence.
cashflow_specification.fees: Entry and exit fees booked per venue; rebalancing fees booked when the frozen collateral policy causes trades or transfers.
cashflow_specification.slippage: Observed from provenance-quality execution data if available. Otherwise primary executable-return claims remain blocked and only pre-slippage or break-even-slippage diagnostics may be produced in a later authorized phase.
cashflow_specification.collateral_fx_basis: USDT and USDC are distinct ledger assets; 1:1 equivalence may be used only as an explicitly labeled accounting convention with depeg stress tests frozen separately.
cashflow_specification.opportunity_cost: Charged on capital actually immobilized, not merely on net portfolio notional. Primary benchmark candidate is a pre-registered USD risk-free proxy; exact official series must be frozen before economic evaluation.

execution_cost_policy.historical_fee_rule: Prefer date-matched public base fee schedules. If a material historical fee regime cannot be dated, a full executable historical claim is blocked rather than filled with a favorable guess.
execution_cost_policy.slippage_rule: No mid-price fill assumption. No fixed favorable slippage imputation. If L2 is insufficient, record UNOBSERVABLE and calculate only allowed bounded diagnostics after separate authorization.

margin_and_capital_policy.liquidation_handling: Any venue-level liquidation or forced deleveraging ends that path and books the frozen loss/cost convention; profit at the other venue cannot retroactively prevent it.
margin_and_capital_policy.capital_efficiency_denominator: Must include capital posted on both venues plus frozen reserve/buffer capital.

pre_freeze_gates.requirement: BTC/ETH and primary orientation fixed before own-data outcomes
Official funding and mechanism sources identified; historical coverage audit pending
Acquire/hash/audit raw records without evaluating economics
Date base taker fee regimes or block executable claim
L2/fill provenance passes or execution remains UNOBSERVABLE
Freeze leverage, maintenance margin, buffer and rebalancing policy
Freeze official benchmark series and accrual convention
Freeze deterministic common historical replication window from provenance only
Historical overlap cannot count as independent confirmation; 2026 remains locked
Separate explicit authorization after all material pre-freeze gates pass

full_freeze_go_condition: G03,G04,G06,G08,G09,G10 must PASS; G07 must either PASS or be explicitly frozen UNOBSERVABLE with executable-return claims blocked. No economic outcomes may have been inspected to resolve these gates.
full_freeze_no_go_conditions: Cannot reconstruct realized funding cashflows unambiguously for both venues
Cannot date material funding interval/scaling regimes
Cannot define venue-separate margin/collateral mechanics without future information
Required provenance would access locked 2026 outcomes or MEXC locked data
The candidate requires dynamic tuning before the static low-turnover baseline can be evaluated
final_note: A successful historical adversarial replication is only a promotion gate to untouched prospective validation; it is not independent proof of edge.
